text: Chip Fields played Rochelle, one of J.J.'s girlfriends, in "J.J.'s New Career, Part 2" (Season 4, aired November 17, 1976), per [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chip_Fields) and [TVmaze](https://www.tvmaze.com/characters/204646/good-times-rochelle). Your team note says the answer is Penny or Thelma, but neither source supports that, and I couldn't find evidence for either name, so I'm keeping Rochelle unless you have a source for the note. CONFIDENCE: 80
